usedFor: Hostfully holds rental bookings, and Brevo lists the guest after “New Booking” through “Add Contacts To List”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Booking” in Hostfully, then “Add Contacts To List” in Brevo
bestTemplate.why: It adds guests to a chosen contact list by email, contact ID or external ID.

watchOut: “Add Contacts To List” works on existing contacts, so create the guest in Brevo first.
